name: com.vgeo.virtualgeometry
description: Virtual geometry for Unity 6: offline cluster DAG with continuous LOD, GPU-driven culling, visibility buffer, page streaming. HDRP 17 and URP 17 (RenderGraph). D3D12 first, Vulkan second.

samples.description: HDRP. Builds a dense scanned quarry from your Megascans downloads (Tools > VGeo > Samples > Quarry Scene imports them) or from procedural rocks, as virtual geometry; flythrough, stats overlay, V switches to Unity's renderers (Mesh LOD, LODGroups, terrain) for comparisons.
